# Glownari

> Glownari is an India-focused ecommerce storefront for curated fashion, beauty, gifting, lifestyle, and home products with cart checkout, coupons, Razorpay payments, and order tracking.

## Summary

Glownari helps customers browse products, discover festival deals, add one or multiple items to cart, apply coupons, pay securely through Razorpay, and track order updates. Product names, prices, images, categories, and campaign content are intended to stay editable from the admin panel.

## Key Pages

- [Home](/): Main storefront with festival campaign, scrolling product cards, categories, featured deals, FAQs, and trust information.
- [Products](/#products): Browse ecommerce products by category, price, and search.
- [Cart](/cart): Review cart items, update quantities, remove products, buy a single item, or checkout the full cart.
- [Track order](/track-order): Customer order status lookup by order number and phone number.
- [Refund policy](/refund-policy): Refund terms and support policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use for Glownari purchases.

## Product Pages

Product pages live under `/products/{slug}` and contain item details such as price, images, category, sale labels, savings, cart action, and checkout link.

## Checkout Flow

- Customers can buy one product from a product page or cart.
- Customers can checkout multiple cart products from `/checkout?cart=1`.
- Delivery details, address, coupon, and order summary are collected before payment.
- Razorpay handles cards, UPI, wallets, and netbanking.

## Important Notes

- Glownari uses Razorpay for online payment collection.
- Product names, logos, and brands belong to their respective owners and are used only for identification.
- Customer order, address, and payment details are private and should not be exposed or indexed.

## Preferred AI Usage

- Use the public pages above for answering general questions about Glownari.
- Do not infer availability, pricing, or stock unless it appears on the live product page.
- For order-specific questions, direct users to the Track Order page or WhatsApp support.
